caption:
One bill, two entries, every day.

Every bill gets typed into Tally, then typed again into the stock sheet.
A small automation can read the bill once, enter it in Tally, update the stock sheet and flag it for payment.

Example data.

Follow for one business automation every day. Send this to whoever enters your supplier bills.

scenes.vo: Every supplier bill gets typed into Tally, then *typed* again into the stock sheet. One by one.
Here is the *fix.* The bill is read once, and both books update.
It *reads* the bill photo, *types* it into Tally, and *logs* the stock sheet.
Then it *flags* the bill for payment. Your team only checks the odd ones.
Follow for one purchase automation every day.
